description: Platform actions and resource types as Catalog holds them. `actions` keeps catalog order (built-ins, then configured actions, then plugin actions in plugin order: application plugins, inference, ssh, verifiable credentials). Tenant-defined actions and types come from the actions/resourceTypes collections.

addedResourceTypes.name: credential-type

rules: Configured and plugin actions may not start with iam: or tenant/ and may not contain *, ? or whitespace (INVALID_CONFIG "Reserved or invalid action").
Attribute types are string, number or boolean; tenantId is never an attribute name.
Tenant actions need permissions.mode tenant-defined (CATALOG_LOCKED 403) and an existing tenant resource type named by their prefix.
